site.title: WALDO IS A PSYOP
site.subtitle: The case files. Every scene. Every stripe. Every "coincidence."
intro: They tell you to FIND him. Have you ever asked yourself ==why he keeps needing to be found?== One scene is a coincidence. Two is a pattern. I have a whole folder.
Pick a case file. Look at the evidence. Then look at it ~~again~~ AGAIN. I'm just asking questions.
site.footer: This is a parody. Waldo is a fictional character created by Martin Handford. No actual investigation occurred. No real person in any picture is identified or targeted.
